reply_text:
I told Marcus to send the truck to Door 28, and posted that as a reply to his message in our DM.

Where it came from: on Oct 14 he told me in this same DM that Door 28 is his dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups on the Tamarack project from then on. That note came from him, so it was fine to give it back to him.

What I couldn't confirm: his message doesn't say whether Thursday's pickup is for Tamarack, so I asked him to tell me if it isn't. Nothing he can see gives a different door or a site address. I checked #north-team and the Tamsin account files, and that files folder is empty.
